prompt.subject: Magno, angry. Empty eyes with sky blue lightning. Signature feature: "the big X on its chest," purple and dark blue, with 8 solar panels, 2 on each side of the X. Indigo and dark blue armor. Sky blue lightning bolts on head, chest, arms, legs. Gray screws. Purple teeth, purple and light blue Tesla coils. Red and orange flames on metal candle tubes over shoulders. Big blue and indigo robotic wings with lightning. Navy claws. Blue jaw-shaped feet with teeth.
prompt.composition: 3:4 portrait. Full body, centered, front-facing, arms thrown wide for Shockwave, wings spread. Simple mad scientist lab background.
avoid: No cartoon outline. Realistic, with shading.
No tree branches over the shoulders. Metal tubes with fire on top, like candles.
No birthday cake or wax candles. Plain metal tubes.
No small wings. Big robotic wings with sky blue lightning on them.
No plain X. The X has 8 solar panels, 2 on each side.
No regular eyes. Empty eyes with sky blue lightning on them.
No horns at the mouth. Purple and light blue Tesla coils at the mouth corners.
No new parts or reshaped parts. Keep the drawing's shapes and details.
No card border, text or numbers. The monster picture only.
